cleared.check: What in src/ would compute or decide something else if these journals kept a transient credit while the token transfer rolled back.
cleared.result: Nothing differs on these builds. The deltas are transient words written by tload and tstore in CurrencyDelta.applyDelta (src/libraries/CurrencyDelta.sol:34-40), the count by NonzeroDeltaCount (src/libraries/NonzeroDeltaCount.sol:18-33), the lock by Lock (src/libraries/Lock.sol:10-20), and unlock reverts unless the count is zero (src/PoolManager.sol:104-113). A settle in an inner frame credits the caller through _settle (src/PoolManager.sol:349-361) and _accountDelta; if that frame reverts, the lifted World Chain and Zora journals restore the delta word, the count and the synced currency and reserves to their pre-frame values together with the token balance, in every one of the 22114 reverts run and in the 400 live probes. A committed inner frame keeps its writes until an outer revert undoes them, as revm specifies. So an ordinary account cannot keep a credit from a reverted settle, a reverted take or mint cannot leave a debit erased, and no ERC-6909 balance or pool slot can survive the revert that undoes the payment for it on these builds.
